modules.name: Journal
modules.site: Once a day you write down what got in your way and what's on your mind. The journal reads it back, names what keeps showing up, and builds the list of things worth fixing, in your words.

modules.name: Research
modules.site: Someone has already solved most of the problems on your desk. Research finds what they learned, checks it, and hands it back aimed at the decision in front of you, not a page of reading.

modules.name: Overwatch
modules.site: Overwatch is the system everything else runs in. It works from what your journal found, builds the checklists, drafts, and routines you named, and keeps one board that shows the whole operation at a glance.

modules.name: Focus
modules.site: A protected hour with nothing assigned to it is the first thing you give away. Focus makes the block the unit you plan in, each one with a result it has to produce by the end.

modules.name: Task Triage
modules.site: Lists in six places, and you still lie awake running the seventh. Triage gets every open commitment out where you can see it, sorts what's real from what isn't, and closes the list for the day.

modules.name: Inbox
modules.site: Inbox zero was never about the message count. It was about the decisions still open in your head. Inbox works on those, on a schedule you set, with one urgent channel so nothing real gets missed.

modules.name: People
modules.site: Most of the people taking your time aren't the problem. Your yes is. People reads who has a claim on your week and what you agreed to, then helps you change the terms you can, and honor the ones you can't.

modules.name: Prompt
modules.site: Writing instructions is easy. Writing ones that still work in six weeks, that you actually follow, and that fail where you can see it is the whole job, and Prompt does it with you.

modules.name: Examen
modules.site: Once a week Examen reads everything you've recorded, your entries, your board, your calendar, and hands back the ten facts and ten questions that matter most this week. Then you decide.
